But we have displayCarStatus with option "fuel". That likely displays fuel status. So we need to call displayCarStatus with option "fuel". Then after that, we can decide how much to fill. The user hasn't specified the amount yet. They want to fill the tank. We might ask them how many gallons they want to add. Or we could just fill to full. But the user said "I want to fill my car's fuel tank, but first I need to confirm the current fuel level to determine how much to add." So we should first display fuel status. Then ask them how many gallons to add. Then call fillFuelTank.

Thus step 1: call displayCarStatus with option "fuel".
